cases.title: US006-21_01_Set_in_Settings_LED_signal_8262_SIP
cases.custom_description:
A) Objective :

The aim of this test is to check the setting LED signal

B) Equipment and system configuration

\- 1 System (Rainbow office, Rainbow hub, OXE or OXO)
\- 1 Base station : DECT Base Station (any kind of base station)
\- 1 DECT mobile : 8214 DECT = DUT (Device Under Test)
\- 1 DECT charger

custom_steps_separated.content: \- In application menu screen, select/activate Settings/LED signal
custom_steps_separated.expected:
three different colors:
• Green LED
• Yellow LED
• Red LED
• Charger LED

custom_steps_separated.content:
The different colors can be assigned to distinctive situations by the user
• Missed call:
The LED signal blinks in the chosen color when there is a missed call.
• Voice message:
The LED signal blinks in the chosen color when there is a voice mail message that has not been listened to.
• Low battery:
The LED signals blinks in the chosen color when the battery is low (below 20% battery on the handset).
• Off:
The LED signal is disabled, and does not blink in any situation.

Charger LED
• On (default): Red LED is continuously "on" when on charger and charging else when fully charged the Green LED is continuously "on".
Case Red LED is configured to notify a missed call or Voice mail message AND Red LED is continuously "on" (charging), then the Red LED is put "off" two
times during the notification.
Case Red LED is configured to notify a missed call or Voice mail message AND Green LED is continuously "on" (charged), then the Red LED is blinking two
times during the notification.
Case Green LED is configured to notify a missed call or Voice mail message AND Red LED is continuously "on" (charging), then the Green LED is blinking two
times during the notification.
Case Green LED is configured to notify a missed call or Voice mail message AND Green LED is continuously "on" (charged), then the Green LED is put "off"
two times during the notification.
Case Orange LED is configured to notify a missed call or Voice mail message AND Red LED is continuously "on" (charging), then the Orange LED is blinking
two times during the notification.
Case Orange LED is configured to notify a missed call or Voice mail message AND Green LED is continuously "on" (charged), then the Orange LED is blinking
two times during the notification.
• Off: the Red LED or Green LED are not continously "on" on the charger ; the LEDs are following the LED notification described in the Green LED or Yellow
LED or Red LED settings above
custom_steps_separated.expected: Check all the status are OK
